## Checklist

- [ ] It's my own work. Any classic idea is in my own style, with no copied names, characters, art, music or levels.
- [ ] It's fine for every age: no gore, nothing scary or rude, no gambling, ads, tracking or purchases, and no quizzes or lessons.
- [ ] The folder holds one self-contained `index.html` and a `README.md`, and nothing loads from the internet.
- [ ] It plays with a controller, a keyboard, a mouse and touch.
- [ ] It has an **All Games** menu item, and my name is in `<meta name="author">` and on the menu screen.
- [ ] I added a card to `index.html`, a row to `README.md` and the folder name to `GAMES` in `sw.js`.
- [ ] `node tools/check-games.mjs` passes.
- [ ] I tried it on a phone, or with the phone view in Chrome's device toolbar.
